document: Minutes of a meeting (general assembly, board meeting) with attendees, agenda and resolutions, Hungarian
glossary: Document type: Minutes of a meeting (general assembly, board meeting) with attendees, agenda and resolutions, Hungarian. Field names are English identifiers; the document text is verbatim, usually Hungarian.

field_specs.organization_name: the organization name as printed on the document (A szervezet/egyesulet neve, amelynek ulese a dokumentum targya (pl. Epitok Hockey Club))
field_specs.document_kind: the document kind as printed on the document (A dokumentum fajtaja a csaladon belul: jegyzokonyv / kozgyulesi meghivo / jelenleti iv)
field_specs.meeting_type: the meeting type as printed on the document (Az ules tipusa)
field_specs.meeting_date: the meeting date as printed on the document (Az ules (vagy meghivoban a tervezett ules) datuma, ISO YYYY-MM-DD)
field_specs.location: the location as printed on the document (Az ules helyszine, ahogy a dokumentumon szerepel)
field_specs.attendee_count: the attendee count as printed on the document (Jelenlevok szama, ha a szoveg megallapitja (pl. '14 tag van jelen'))
field_specs.chair_name: the chair name as printed on the document (Levezeto elnok neve)
field_specs.minutes_keeper: the minutes keeper as printed on the document (Jegyzokonyvvezeto neve)
